items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I think it was about '43 when they got George Durivier, and they probably still had Panama in the band.

ctx.x: But I think it was the next year that -- yeah, I think it was the next year, '43, that -- Andy Gibson told me that that was the year when that was the great band of Lucky Millinder's, he said he wrote a lot of arrangements for them and he got a strong band, and this was another casualty that -- just as you can't hear Parker and (unintelligible) Dizzy with Earl you can't hear Lucky Miller with this band, the following year.
Well, now, I do remember -- I think it was about '43 when they got George Durivier, and they probably still had Panama in the band.
